# ContinuousReader

> A native multiplatform reading app for macOS, iPadOS, and iPhone. One codebase, three platform-adapted experiences. Built in Swift and SwiftUI.

ContinuousReader is an independent reading app by Oleksii Koshkin. It reads EPUB, FB2, MOBI, HTML, TXT, RTF and — on Mac — DOC/DOCX files (and their ZIP variants). The core value proposition is seamless reading position sync across all Apple devices via iCloud.

## Three products

One picture explains the family: JustReader is the book on your nightstand, PlainReader is the bookshelf, ContinuousReader is the library.

- **ContinuousReader** ($19.99, one-time) — full reading workspace: library with folders and global full-text search, iCloud sync, OPDS catalogs with watchers, mass import, reading statistics
- **PlainReader** ($6.99, one-time) — up to 25 books open in parallel, each in its own place with its own position; no collection to manage. OPDS browser, shared searchable history of the last 25 books, colour tags
- **JustReader** (free) — one book at a time, with the same engine, typography, themes, translation and Read Aloud

All three share the ReaderCore engine (local Swift Package), so the reading experience — themes, typography, navigation modes, translation, Read Aloud, bookmarks, per-book notes, reading statistics and the Book Card — is the same in all of them. What differs is how much collection management sits on top.

## Key features

### Reading engine
- WKWebView-based renderer with PositionTracker.js for precise position tracking
- Three navigation modes: continuous scroll, single page, two-page spread (Mac, iPad in landscape)
- 41 reading themes (5 palette families x 7 tones + 3 featured themes — Typewriter, Terminal, Norton — + 3 custom slots); the Typewriter theme adopts a quiet steampunk styling for its bottom bar (brass dashboard speedometer with a rolling needle on wider bars, vintage radio-dial carriage with a lit red pointer on narrower bars, copper keycaps, mechanical drum-counter read-outs); Norton is a retro file-manager-style frame with an NC-blue bar
- 9 system fonts (serif, sans, monospace), full typography control
- Day & Night mode (automatic theme switching based on system appearance)
- Reading position survives font changes, window resizes, device switches, mode switches

### Translation
- Apple Translation framework (on-device, nothing leaves the device)
- Non-disruptive inline panel, auto-translate mode
- Translation statistics and history tracking (optional)

### Voice Reader (Read Aloud)
- Text-to-speech with real-time word highlighting
- Adjustable rate, pitch, volume
- Seamless handoff between reading and listening (same position)

### Library (ContinuousReader only; PlainReader has a 25-place shelf instead)
- Three view modes: list, cards (4 sizes), table (native on Mac)
- Nested virtual folders, color tags (7 colors), genres, Trash with soft delete
- OPDS catalog browser with shortcuts and watchers (watchers diff feeds against the library and flag books you don't own yet)
- Mass import walking folder trees, deduplicating, and replicating the source structure as folders (Mac)
- Book Card with tabs (Cover/Images/Info/Notes/Bookmarks/Stats) — shared by all three apps; only ContinuousReader can edit a book's own details
- Global search across the full text of every book in the library, jumping straight to the hit
- Interface depth (Flat / Standard / Deep) and an accent colour that reaches every window and sheet
- Rich text notes editor per book
- Reading statistics dashboard + shareable HTML reports
- Self-contained library folder — copy it anywhere for a backup; custom library location (Mac)

### iCloud sync (ContinuousReader only)
- Reading positions sync in real time while reading (with an iCloud KV Store backup); bookmarks, notes, library metadata via iCloud KV Store
- Book files via iCloud Drive
- Master/slave model for concurrent reading (one device owns position per book)
- Works with free iCloud tier for reading state; file sync uses iCloud Drive storage
- Sync panel reachable by tapping the cloud status badge — shows transport state, library stats (books / downloaded / size with on-demand exact disk scan), and Apple-Settings-style list of connected devices with last-activity timestamps. Foreground-only heartbeat (no fake "online" from a backgrounded Mac or locked iPhone). Forget a peer device via context menu (Mac) or swipe (iPhone).

### Platform adaptations
- **Mac**: keyboard shortcuts (F1-F10), floating panels, island design, drag-and-drop, two-page spread
- **iPad**: swipe gestures, native sheets, external keyboard support
- **iPhone**: one-hand-friendly, bottom tap zones, compact layouts, notch/Dynamic Island-aware fullscreen

## Technical details

- **Stack**: Swift, SwiftUI, WKWebView, SwiftData
- **Minimum OS**: iOS 17.0, macOS 14.0
- **Storage**: SwiftData (local), iCloud KV Store + iCloud Drive (sync)
- **Book storage**: Clean HTML files on disk with readable slug-based folder names
- **Shipped version**: 1.4 "Admiral" (2026-08-13) for ContinuousReader and JustReader; PlainReader ships as 1.4 as well — the number tracks the shared engine generation, not each app
- **Privacy**: No analytics, no telemetry, no tracking. Translation is on-device.
- **Localization**: English + Russian, Ukrainian, Spanish, French, German (930+ keys)
- **Bundle IDs**: com.lexey111.ContinuousReader, com.lexey111.PlainReader, com.lexey111.JustReader

## Formats supported

EPUB, FB2, FB2.ZIP, MOBI, HTML, TXT, RTF, DOC/DOCX (Mac only), and ZIP variants of HTML/TXT/RTF/DOC.
Footnote extraction from EPUB and FB2. Chapter extraction. Cover detection. Encoding auto-detection.
